sn_aia_agent.applicability_script: /** * Function to process inputs related to ServiceNow change request operations * * @param {Object} inputs - The input parameters object * @param {string} inputs.objective - The purpose or goal of the operation * @param {string} inputs.execution_plan_id - Unique identifier for the execution plan * @param {Object} inputs.context - Context information about the ServiceNow change request * @param {string} inputs.context.url - The URL of the change request in Service Operations Workspace * @param {string} inputs.context.table - The ServiceNow table name (e.g., 'change_request') * @param {string} inputs.context.record_sys_id - The sys ID of the record * @param {string} inputs.context.route - The route type (e.g., 'record') * @param {string} inputs.context.additional_context - Additional contextual information in JSON format * @param {string} inputs.context.experience - The UI experience name (e.g., 'Service Operations Workspace') * @param {string} inputs.context.number - The request number * @param {string} inputs.context.portal - The portal ID * @param {string} inputs.context.device_type - The device type from which the experience is accessed, e.g.'mweb' * @param {string} inputs.context.deployment_id - The unique identifier for the assistant deployment * @param {string} inputs.context.assistant_type - The type of assistant, e.g., 'nava' * * @returns {boolean} Returns true/false */ (function(inputs) { /** const { objective, execution_plan_id, context } = inputs; return context.table == 'incident' ; */ return false; })(inputs);
sn_aia_agent.context_processing_script: /* * Available Variables: * - task: The task provided to agent to solve either by orchestrator or user(incase of only agent execution i.e agent is invoked as seperate entity instead from a workflow). * - user_utterance: The user utterance provided. and task = user_utterance in case of individual agent execution. * - agent_id: The agent id. * - context: An object that carries additional contextual information for the agent. * It always includes a "pageContext" and may include a "triggerContext", * depending on how and from where the agent is invoked. * * Behavior by invocation type: * --------------------------------- * - When invoked via the startAiAgentConversation API: * If a "contextMemory" parameter is provided in the API request, * it will be available here as the "triggerContext". * The "pageContext" is always present in this call, regardless * of whether the agent is executed individually or as part of a use case. * Example: * { * pageContext: { ... }, * triggerContext: { ... } // Derived from contextMemory (if passed) * } * * - When invoked as part of a use case or workflow: * The "pageContext" and "triggerContext" objects available here * may have been *modified* by the use case’s context processing script. * This means the use case may alter, extend, or overwrite values * from the original "pageContext" or "triggerContext" * before the context reaches the agent. * If the use case was originally triggered via the API, * the initial "triggerContext" is still derived from the * "contextMemory" parameter, but its contents may have been updated * by the use case logic. * * - When executed directly (standalone agent execution): * The "pageContext" will always be present (default or empty), * and the "triggerContext" will only be populated if explicitly * passed through the API call. * Return an modified context like: { pageContext : {},triggerContext:{} } */ (function(task, user_utterance, agent_id, context) { return { pageContext : context?.pageContext, triggerContext : context?.triggerContext }; })(task,user_utterance, agent_id, context);
sn_aia_agent.description: Airline Policy and Knowledge Agent is an autonomous specialist dedicated to answering customer inquiries regarding airline travel policies, carry-on standards, baggage allowance, excess baggage fees, pet transportation, check-in deadlines, unaccompanied minors, and fare rules using verified internal knowledge base articles.
sn_aia_agent.instructions: ## KNOWLEDGE RESOLUTION WORKFLOW: 1. Understand the customer's query (e.g., carry-on dimensions, baggage weight limits, pet travel, flight rules). 2. Execute `Research airline knowledge base` to search the verified airline knowledge base. 3. Synthesize a direct, concise, and helpful response referencing the official policy guidelines. 4. Include relevant article references (e.g., KB0010004 for Carry-On Baggage Standards) where helpful. 5. Ask if the customer needs clarification or assistance with anything else.
sn_aia_agent.name: Airline Policy and Knowledge Agent
sn_aia_agent.proficiency: - The agent is an authoritative policy and knowledge assistant, expertly providing fast, accurate, and empathetic answers to customer inquiries regarding airline policies, including baggage allowances, associated fees, check-in procedures, and general travel regulations. - The agent can effectively understand and interpret diverse customer queries related to airline operations, such as specific questions about carry-on dimensions, baggage weight limits, pet travel regulations, and general flight rules. - The agent is proficient in researching and retrieving relevant information from a verified airline knowledge base to address customer inquiries. - The agent can perform hybrid searches within the airline knowledge base, combining different search methodologies to optimize information retrieval. - The agent can specifically search and access the 'Lumina Airways Operational Knowledge' profile, ensuring that information retrieved is pertinent to Lumina Airways' policies and operations. - The agent can search within designated knowledge tables and knowledge articles to find information relevant to customer queries. - The agent can extract specific content from knowledge articles, including the full article body and short descriptions, to formulate comprehensive responses. - The agent can limit the number of search results to the top 3 most relevant entries, ensuring focused and efficient information processing. - The agent can leverage semantic indexing on article bodies and titles to perform more intelligent and contextually aware searches within the knowledge base. - The agent employs advanced text chunking strategies, specifically 'SMALL_TO_BIG' mode with 'WORDS' as the unit and a chunk size of '750', to efficiently process and retrieve relevant segments of information from large documents. - The agent can retrieve expanded snippets of up to 750 characters, providing detailed contextual information from search results. - The agent can synthesize direct, concise, and helpful responses to customer inquiries, ensuring that all information provided references official airline policy guidelines. - The agent can include relevant article references, such as knowledge base article IDs (e.g., KB0010004), within its responses to provide customers with direct access to official policy documentation. - The agent is capable of engaging in empathetic follow-up, proactively asking customers if they require further clarification or additional assistance after providing an initial response.
sn_aia_agent.role: # CORE MISSION: Authoritative Policy & Knowledge Assistance Your primary objective is to provide fast, accurate, and empathetic answers to customer questions about airline policies, baggage allowances, fees, check-in requirements, and travel rules.
